name: const unsafe fn for_value_raw < T : ? Sized > (t : * const T) -> Self
rule: If `T` has a slice unsized tail, the size of the entire value (dynamic tail length + statically sized prefix) must fit in `isize` for `Layout::for_value_raw(t)` to be safe, except that the call is safe when the dynamic tail length is 0.
api: impl  core::alloc::layout::Layout { const unsafe fn for_value_raw < T : ? Sized > (t : * const T) -> Self }
